mapper.sql: id, user_id, display_name, headline, bio, languages::text AS languages, area_province_codes::text AS area_province_codes, years_experience, avatar_url, contact_phone, contact_email, status, submitted_at, decided_at, decided_by, decision_note, information_requested, plan, plan_expires_at, response_minutes_avg, completed_bookings, rating_average, rating_count, created_at, updated_at

id, guide_id, title, summary, itinerary, duration_hours, max_guests, meeting_point, province_code, inclusions::text AS inclusions, exclusions::text AS exclusions, pricing_mode, price_amount, currency, advance_notice_hours, status, is_promoted, created_at, updated_at

id, service_id, guide_id, traveler_id, booking_date, guest_count, traveler_note, currency, service_amount, platform_fee_percent, platform_fee_amount, guide_payout_amount, fee_rule_version, status, payment_status, respond_by, confirmed_at, completed_at, cancelled_at, cancellation_reason, dispute_opened_at, payout_released_at, payout_frozen, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guide_profiles (id, user_id, display_name, headline, bio, languages, area_province_codes, years_experience, avatar_url, contact_phone, contact_email, status, plan, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{displayName}, #{headline}, #{bio}, #{languages}::jsonb, #{areaProvinceCodes}::jsonb, #{yearsExperience}, #{avatarUrl}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{status}, #{plan}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE guide_profiles SET display_name = #{displayName}, headline = #{headline}, bio = #{bio}, languages = #{languages}::jsonb, area_province_codes = #{areaProvinceCodes}::jsonb, years_experience = #{yearsExperience}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE guide_profiles SET status = 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', submitted_at = NOW(), information_requested = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED')

UPDATE guide_profiles SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = NOW(), decision_note = #{decisionNote}, information_requested = #{informationRequested}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guide_profiles WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM guide_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guide_profiles AND status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE guide_profiles g SET completed_bookings = COALESCE(stats.completed, 0), rating_average = stats.rating_average, rating_count = COALESCE(stats.rating_count, 0), response_minutes_avg = stats.response_minutes, updated_at = NOW() FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guide_bookings b WHERE b.guide_id = #{guideId} AND b.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) FROM guide_reviews r WHERE r.guide_id = #{guideId} AND r.is_removed = FALSE) AS rating_average, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guide_reviews r WHERE r.guide_id = #{guideId} AND r.is_removed = FALSE) AS rating_count, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.confirmed_at - b.created_at)) / 60)) FROM guide_bookings b WHERE b.guide_id = #{guideId} AND b.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS response_minutes ) AS stats WHERE g.id = #{guideId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guide_identity_documents (id, guide_id, document_type, file_url, purge_after) VALUES (#{id}, #{guideId}, #{documentType}, #{fileUrl}, #{purgeAfter})
mapper.select: SELECT id, document_type, file_url, uploaded_at, purge_after, purged_at FROM guide_identity_documents WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} AND purged_at IS NULL ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
SELECT id, guide_id, file_url FROM guide_identity_documents WHERE purged_at IS NULL AND purge_after <= NOW() ORDER BY purge_after LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE guide_identity_documents SET purged_at = NOW(), file_url = '' WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guide_services (id, guide_id, title, summary, itinerary, duration_hours, max_guests, meeting_point, province_code, inclusions, exclusions, pricing_mode, price_amount, currency, advance_notice_hours, status, is_promoted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{guideId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{itinerary}, #{durationHours}, #{maxGuests}, #{meetingPoint}, #{provinceCode}, #{inclusions}::jsonb, #{exclusions}::jsonb, #{pricingMode}, #{priceAmount}, #{currency}, #{advanceNoticeHours}, #{status}, #{isPromoted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE guide_services SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, itinerary = #{itinerary}, duration_hours = #{durationHours}, max_guests = #{maxGuests}, meeting_point = #{meetingPoint}, province_code = #{provinceCode}, inclusions = #{inclusions}::jsonb, exclusions = #{exclusions}::jsonb, pricing_mode = #{pricingMode}, price_amount = #{priceAmount}, currency = #{currency}, advance_notice_hours = #{advanceNoticeHours}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND guide_id = #{guideId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guide_services WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM guide_services WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guide_services WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} AND status = 'LISTED'
mapper.sql:
FROM guide_services s JOIN guide_profiles g ON g.id = s.guide_id WHERE s.status = 'LISTED' AND g.status = 'APPROVED' AND s.province_code = #{provinceCode} AND s.price_amount <= #{maxPrice} AND g.languages @> to_jsonb(#{language}::text)
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM guide_availability a WHERE a.guide_id = g.id AND a.available_date = #{date} AND a.is_blocked = TRUE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)
mapper.update: UPDATE guide_services SET status = 'PAUSED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} AND status = 'LISTED' AND id NOT IN ( SELECT id FROM guide_services WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} AND status = 'LISTED' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{keep})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guide_availability (id, guide_id, available_date, is_blocked, max_guests, note) VALUES (#{id}, #{guideId}, #{availableDate}, #{isBlocked}, #{maxGuests}, #{note}) ON CONFLICT (guide_id, available_date) DO UPDATE SET is_blocked = EXCLUDED.is_blocked, max_guests = EXCLUDED.max_guests, note = EXCLUDED.note
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM guide_availability WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} AND available_date = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guide_bookings (id, service_id, guide_id, traveler_id, booking_date, guest_count, traveler_note, currency, service_amount, platform_fee_percent, platform_fee_amount, guide_payout_amount, fee_rule_version, status, payment_status, respond_by, payout_frozen, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{serviceId}, #{guideId}, #{travelerId}, #{bookingDate}, #{guestCount}, #{travelerNote}, #{currency}, #{serviceAmount}, #{platformFeePercent}, #{platformFeeAmount}, #{guidePayoutAmount}, #{feeRuleVersion}, #{status}, #{paymentStatus}, #{respondBy}, FALSE, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guide_bookings WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM guide_bookings WHERE traveler_id = #{travelerId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE guide_bookings SET status = #{status}, payment_status = COALESCE(#{paymentStatus}, payment_status), cancellation_reason = COALESCE(#{reason}, cancellation_reason), confirmed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CONFIRMED' THEN NOW() ELSE confirmed_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'COMPLETED' THEN NOW() ELSE completed_at END, cancelled_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('CANCELLED', 'DECLINED', 'EXPIRED') THEN NOW() ELSE cancelled_at END, dispute_opened_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DISPUTED' THEN NOW() ELSE dispute_opened_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
UPDATE guide_bookings SET payout_frozen = #{frozen}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE guide_bookings SET payout_released_at = NOW(), payment_status = 'RELEASED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND payout_released_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guide_bookings WHERE status = 'REQUESTED' AND respond_by IS NOT NULL AND respond_by < NOW() ORDER BY respond_by LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM guide_bookings WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND payout_released_at IS NULL AND payout_frozen = FALSE AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at <= #{releasableBefore} ORDER BY completed_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guide_payout_entries (id, booking_id, guide_id, entry_type, amount, currency, reverses_entry_id, reference_key, note, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{bookingId}, #{guideId}, #{entryType}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{reversesEntryId}, #{referenceKey}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (reference_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO guide_reviews (id, booking_id, guide_id, traveler_id, rating, comment, is_removed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{bookingId}, #{guideId}, #{travelerId}, #{rating}, #{comment}, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (booking_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM guide_reviews WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}
SELECT * FROM guide_reviews WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} AND is_removed = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guide_service_views (service_id, view_date, view_count, inquiry_count) VALUES (#{serviceId}, CURRENT_DATE, 1, 10) ON CONFLICT (service_id, view_date) DO UPDATE SET view_count = guide_service_views.view_count + 1, inquiry_count = guide_service_views.inquiry_count + 10
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(v.view_count), 0) FROM guide_service_views v JOIN guide_services s ON s.id = v.service_id WHERE s.guide_id = #{guideId} AND v.view_date >= #{from}::date) AS views, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(v.inquiry_count), 0) FROM guide_service_views v JOIN guide_services s ON s.id = v.service_id WHERE s.guide_id = #{guideId} AND v.view_date >= #{from}::date) AS inquiries, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.created_at >= #{from}) AS bookings, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'COMPLETED' AND b.created_at >= #{from}) AS completed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'CANCELLED' AND b.created_at >= #{from}) AS cancelled, COALESCE(SUM(b.guide_payout_amount) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'COMPLETED' AND b.created_at >= #{from}), 0) AS revenue FROM guide_bookings b WHERE b.guide_id = #{guideId}
